notes: Classic per-frame img2img baseline, configured as the upstream realtime-img2img demo: SD-Turbo, TAESD, t_index_list [35, 45], denoising batch, cfg none, demo negative prompt; acceleration none (SDPA) instead of TensorRT. Each text_control instruction is sent verbatim as the new prompt (update_prompt from the next frame; no rewriting or accumulation; CLIP truncates at 77 tokens). Output 640x384 (384x640 portrait, center crop; 512x512-class budget, UNet needs multiples of 64) at up to 30 fps. Source frames are passed through until the first instruction. No reference path.
